# OpenCine source

The six source targets in this directory are copied without source edits from
[OpenCine](https://github.com/erik-sutton95/OpenCine) revision
`1be846d664da0020ef67f039a34f207c0b047404`, pinned by OpenPocketCine.
The package manifest limits the build to the targets used by Pocket Head.
